title: Quentin and the Promise
author: Noor Delacroix
blurb: Sebastian Halloran, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
